title: One-step guarded reachability
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If $G$ holds of configuration $a$, then the one-step successor of $a$ is reachable from $a$ in one step, with $G$ holding at every configuration before the endpoint.
